copy.headline: 3 strangers, 1 rental car: An unlikely road trip from DFW to Tucson
copy.caption:
WATCH: 3 strangers, 1 rental car: An unlikely road trip from DFW to Tucson

Stranded by FAA ground stops, three strangers rented a car at DFW Airport and turned a travel nightmare into an unforgettable road trip and friendship.

Video: WFAA on YouTube
